title: 第1章 米卫兵转生异世第2章 惊世智慧
content_zh:
广明城，烈日高悬！
叶离站在一群少年之中，于城南的空地上站着。
他身材瘦削，粗布麻衣布鞋裹脚，清秀的脸上双眉紧蹙，像是忍受莫大的痛苦！
清风拂面带来丝丝凉意，略微消解酷日下大脑不断传来的阵阵刺痛！
此刻在他的大脑当中，上一世的记忆不断翻涌，一个又一个难以回答的疑问在脑中拼接。
科比到底有没有坠机？
龙族和租借男主谁更龟？
叶天帝和荒天帝哪个更强？
雪中和蛊真人谁才是第五名著？
鸣潮和mc为何不如米游和迷你世界？
火影忍者里的天碍震星是不是抄袭天动万象？
《走近科学》般的疑问犹如气泡从叶离脑中不断升起。
良久他才缓缓吐出一口浊气，眼神彻底恢复清明！
叶离，21世纪的网络流量主播，依靠随口爆典来吸引流量。
在他不断的反串下，直播间常年聚集无数乐子人，将他不断提出的暴论丢到贴、抖、b、知、红、微…等各大网络平台进行轮番拷打。
像是在论战圈说搞笑人物无敌论，在b站说eva最过誉，在某音说主播就是网络乞丐，反米吧串米卫兵……
往日种种，可谓罪孽深重。
这些年他说出的圣经语录，没有100也有80了，主打什么流量高说什么。
事实证明，反串虽然4m，却真的能爆米。
连番操作下来，依靠挑动对立，竟真让他在互联网赚到钱了。

至于说为什么穿越……
当然是没活了，在网友的怂恿下咬了一下打火机。
随即在网友“叶离真死”的冷汗直流中，成功整死了自己。
接下来的事情就无比顺滑了。
在经历了“叶离假死”和“妈妈生的”两件事后，他成功转生到了这个世界。
但记忆似乎有些堵车，一直到自己十八岁成年之后，才恢复。
此时，他才明白这一世的自己所要面对的尴尬处境。
他所属的这个世界，人人18岁成年那天皆有词条。
根据18岁前的不同经历，会觉醒不同词条。
农民可能会觉醒【吃苦耐劳】词条，增加对吃苦这件事的忍耐力。
富人觉醒【奴隶主】词条，对于所有财富低于自身的个体，影响效果+50%
有人天生肾力惊人，获得词条【飞机大王】，耐力+100%！
而叶离……没有词条！
就和那些成年后脸上没有长摄像头的人一样，他已经成年了还是没有任何词条。
这是一种非常罕见的特例，类比阳痿，比蓝色词条出现的概率都低，直接可以宣布是个废人了。
一想到现在的尴尬处境，他的眉宇间不由露出一丝愁容。
正如某个蓝银王师所说：世界上没有废物的词条，只有废物的个人！
可他连词条都没有，入门都找不到方向。
环视一周，叶离只觉得自己就好似混在人群里的哈士奇。
与周围人不同，在记忆恢复前，他虽然没有词条，却没有声张，而是将自己伪装成绿色词条【机敏过人】！
content_en:
Guangming City, the scorching sun is high!
Ye Li stood among a group of teenagers in the open space south of the city.
He has a thin build, and his feet are wrapped in coarse linen clothes and shoes. His delicate face is frowned, as if he is enduring great pain!
The breeze blowing on my face brings a slight coolness, which slightly relieves the constant pain in my brain under the cool sun!
At this moment, in his brain, the memories of the previous life were constantly flooding, and one unanswerable question after another was spliced ​​in his mind.
Did Kobe Bryant crash?
Who is more stupid, the dragon or the rental male protagonist?
Which one is stronger, Emperor Ye Tian or Emperor Huang Tian?
Who is the fifth masterpiece between Xue Zhong and Gu Zhenren?
Why are Mingchao and MC inferior to Miyou and Mini World?
Is Tenzhi Zhenxing in Naruto a plagiarism from Tensei Tensei?
Questions like "Approaching Science" kept rising from Ye Li's mind like bubbles.
After a long time, he slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, and his eyes completely returned to clarity!
Ye Li, a network traffic anchor in the 21st century, relies on casually talking about classics to attract traffic.
Under his constant cross-talk, countless fun-lovers gathered in the live broadcast room all year round, throwing the violent comments he constantly made to major online platforms such as Tie, Dou, B, Zhi, Hong, WeChat, etc. for repeated torture.
For example, in the debate circle, it is said that funny people are invincible, in Bilibili, it is said that EVA is the most overrated, in a certain channel, it is said that anchors are Internet beggars, anti-Miba and Chuanmi guards...
All kinds of sins in the past can be described as serious.
Over the years, the number of Bible quotations he has said has exceeded 80 if not 100. He focuses on what has high traffic.
Facts have proved that although cross-dressing costs 4m, it can really pop rice.
After repeated operations, he actually made money on the Internet by provoking confrontation.
As for why we traveled through time...
Of course he was dead, so he bit the lighter at the instigation of netizens.
Then, in the cold sweat of netizen "Ye Li is really dead", he successfully tortured himself to death.
What happened next was incredibly smooth.
After experiencing the two events of "Ye Li faked his death" and "was born by his mother", he successfully reincarnated into this world.
But the memory seemed to be stuck in a traffic jam, and it was not until he became an adult at the age of eighteen that he recovered.
Only then did he understand the embarrassing situation he had to face in this life.
He belongs to a world where everyone has an entry on the day they turn 18.
Different entries will be awakened based on different experiences before the age of 18.
Farmers may awaken the word "endure hardship" and increase their tolerance for hardship.
The rich man's awakening [slave owner] entry, for all individuals whose wealth is lower than himself, the influence effect is +50%
Someone was born with amazing kidney power and got the entry [Airplane King], with +100% endurance!
And Ye Li...has no entry!
Just like those people who don't have cameras on their faces as adults, he still doesn't have any entries as an adult.
This is a very rare special case. It is similar to impotence. It is less likely to appear than the blue entry. It can be declared as a useless person.
When he thought of his current embarrassing situation, a trace of sadness appeared on his brows.
As a certain Blue Silver King Master said: There are no trash entries in the world, only trash individuals!
But he didn’t even have an entry and couldn’t find the direction to get started.
Looking around, Ye Li felt that he was just like a husky among the crowd.
Unlike the people around him, before his memory was restored, although he had no entry, he did not make any announcement. Instead, he disguised himself as a green entry [exceptionally alert]!
